scope: Regression tests for survivors of the first complete model-weights mutation campaign; second complete campaign finished and failed

review.finding: Existing tests exercised ReadLimits and ConversionLimits validation separately but did not assert that the public WriteOptions validator delegates to both.
Successful cleanup assertions alone cannot distinguish explicit abort from best-effort Drop. The public abort result must propagate a cleanup error.
review.fault_injection: Replace the open spool directory entry with a directory, then assert IoOperation::Cleanup and no published model.

review.finding: Empty name, empty dimensions and rank above four require independent rejection cases.

complete_campaign_v2.command: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo mutants -p bml-model-weights --all-features --cargo-arg=--locked --test-workspace false --jobs 2 --timeout 60 --build-timeout 300 --output target/model-weights-mutations-v2
complete_campaign_v2.comparison: 19 previously missed mutants now caught, including metadata import/preflight, WriteOptions validation, tensor name/rank checks, abort and cleanup errors. Production sources unchanged; no exclusions added.
